items.caption: A human-shaped form of 文 has chest marks; early forms are reported with marks that vary or may be absent. Their referent remains disputed.
items.alt: Modern vector drawing of a standing human-shaped 文, with a small mark on the chest.
items.selection_reason: Shows the human-shaped outline and chest mark discussed for early forms while leaving its interpretation open.

limitations.text: This is a modern vector redraw, not an image of a particular ancient inscription. The early chest marks’ referent and the graph’s earliest sense remain unresolved; tattooing and a proposed meaning ‘great’ are competing interpretations.
